```{r setup, include=FALSE, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(terra)
library(maps)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
```

```{r, label="import data", results="hide", echo=F, cache=T, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# === Load Data ===
location_df <- read.csv("Results/Weather/Location_Date.csv")
```

````{r, label="clean data", results="hide", echo=F, cache=T, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# === Standardize species names for join ===
location_df$species <- tolower(location_df$species)

# === Join datasets ===
df_merged <- location_df

# === Remove rows without coordinates ===
df_clean <- df_merged %>%
  filter(!is.na(Lat_machine_readable), !is.na(Long_machine_readable))

# Filter to USA region (approx bounding box)
df_usa <- df_clean %>%
  filter(
    Long_machine_readable > -130, Long_machine_readable < -60,
    Lat_machine_readable > 20, Lat_machine_readable < 55
  )
```

```{r, label="load koppen raster", results="hide", echo=F, cache=T, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# === Load Köppen Raster ===
koppen_raster <- rast("Analyses/weather_and_geography/Climate_zones_June26_2/koppen_geiger_tif/1991_2020/koppen_geiger_0p00833333.tif") # Replace with actual path

# === Extract Climate Code ===
points_vect <- vect(df_usa, geom = c("Long_machine_readable", "Lat_machine_readable"), crs = "EPSG:4326")
koppen_values <- extract(koppen_raster, points_vect)
```

```{r, label="add koppen codes", results="hide", echo=F, cache=T, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Add extracted climate codes to the data
df_usa$koppen_code <- koppen_values[[2]]

# === Create Full Köppen Label Lookup Table ===
koppen_lookup <- tibble::tibble(
  koppen_code = 1:30,
  koppen_label = c(
    "Tropical, rainforest", "Tropical, monsoon", "Tropical, savannah",
    "Arid, desert, hot", "Arid, desert, cold", "Arid, steppe, hot", "Arid, steppe, cold",
    "Temperate, dry summer, hot summer", "Temperate, dry summer, warm summer", "Temperate, dry summer, cold summer",
    "Temperate, dry winter, hot summer", "Temperate, dry winter, warm summer", "Temperate, dry winter, cold summer",
    "Temperate, no dry season, hot summer", "Temperate, no dry season, warm summer", "Temperate, no dry season, cold summer",
    "Cold, dry summer, hot summer", "Cold, dry summer, warm summer", "Cold, dry summer, cold summer", "Cold, dry summer, very cold winter",
    "Cold, dry winter, hot summer", "Cold, dry winter, warm summer", "Cold, dry winter, cold summer", "Cold, dry winter, very cold winter",
    "Cold, no dry season, hot summer", "Cold, no dry season, warm summer", "Cold, no dry season, cold summer", "Cold, no dry season, very cold winter",
    "Polar, tundra", "Polar, frost"
  )
)
```

```{r, label="merge koppen data", results="hide", echo=F, cache=T, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# === Merge Full Climate Labels into USA Dataset ===
df_usa <- df_usa %>%
  left_join(koppen_lookup, by = "koppen_code")

```

```{r, label="usa map", results="hide", echo=F, cache=T, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

# === Bin climate zones by first letter of Köppen code ===
df_usa <- df_usa %>%
  mutate(climate_group = case_when(
    koppen_code %in% 1:3 ~ "Tropical",
    koppen_code %in% 4:7 ~ "Arid",
    koppen_code %in% 8:16 ~ "Temperate",
    koppen_code %in% 17:28 ~ "Continental",
    koppen_code %in% 29:30 ~ "Polar",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  ))

```

```{r, label="add pc1 plot", results="hide", echo=F, cache=T, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# === Join PC1 Data ===
pca_df <- read.csv("Results/PCA/PCA_Spore_Scores_Aggregated_with_Count.csv") %>%
  mutate(species = tolower(species))

df_usa <- df_usa %>%
  left_join(pca_df %>% dplyr::select(species, PC1_mean), by = "species")
```

```{r, label="usa map", results="hide", echo=F, cache=T, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

# === Plot USA Map Colored by Full Köppen Label ===
usa_map <- map_data("state")
```
```{r, label="plot map", results="hide", echo=F, cache=T, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
usa_map <- map_data("state")

ggplot() +
  geom_polygon(
    data = usa_map, aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group),
    fill = "gray10", color = "white", size = 0.3
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    data = df_usa,
    aes(x = Long_machine_readable, y = Lat_machine_readable,
        fill = PC1_mean, size = PC1_mean),
    shape = 21, color = "black", stroke = 0.5,
    width = 1.5, height = 1.5, alpha = 0.95
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = df_usa,
    aes(x = Long_machine_readable, y = Lat_machine_readable, label = species),
    size = 3, max.overlaps = 50, color = "white"
  ) +
  # Dramatic color scale
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "A", direction = -1, name = "PC1 (Spore Shape)") +
  # Or try this for even more drama:
  # scale_fill_distiller(palette = "Spectral", direction = 1, name = "PC1 (Spore Shape)") +
  # Or a custom gradient:
  # scale_fill_gradientn(colors = c("blue", "cyan", "yellow", "red"), name = "PC1 (Spore Shape)") +
  scale_size_continuous(name = "PC1 (Spore Shape)", range = c(3, 8)) +
  coord_quickmap(xlim = c(-130, -60), ylim = c(20, 55)) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "black", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "black", color = NA),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "black"),
    legend.text = element_text(color = "white"),
    legend.title = element_text(color = "white"),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "white"),
    axis.title = element_text(color = "white"),
    plot.title = element_text(color = "white", face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "white")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Amanita Sample Locations in the USA",
    subtitle = "Dot Size = PC1_mean, Colored by PC1",
    x = "Longitude", y = "Latitude"
  )
```

```{r, label="save map", results="hide", echo=F, cache=T, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
ggsave("usa_amanita_pc1_map.png", width = 20, height = 12, dpi = 300)
```

```{r, label="boxplot climate group", echo=F, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Load libraries (if not already)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# Perform t-test
t_result <- t.test(PC1_mean ~ climate_group, data = df_usa)
p_val <- signif(t_result$p.value, 3)
p_label <- paste0("t-test p = ", p_val)

# Make the boxplot
ggplot(df_usa, aes(x = climate_group, y = PC1_mean, fill = climate_group)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.shape = NA, size = 1.2) +  # thicker lines
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.5, size = 4, color = "black") +  # bigger points
  annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = max(df_usa$PC1_mean, na.rm = TRUE) + 0.05, 
           label = p_label, size = 8, fontface = "bold") +  # add p-value
  theme_minimal(base_size = 18) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(size = 22, face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 20)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "PC1 (Spore Shape) by Binned Climate Group",
    x = "Binned Köppen Climate Group",
    y = "PC1 Mean (Spore Shape)"
  )


```

```{r, label="save boxplot", echo=F, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
ggsave("PC1_by_Climate_Group_Box_Whisker.jpg", width = 12, height = 7, dpi = 300)
```


```{r, label="climate map w pc1", echo=F, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

usa_map <- map_data("state")

ggplot() +
  # USA map base layer
  geom_polygon(
    data = usa_map, 
    aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group),
    fill = "gray95", color = "gray70"
  ) +
  
  # Jittered Amanita locations
  geom_jitter(
    data = df_usa,
    aes(
      x = Long_machine_readable,
      y = Lat_machine_readable,
      fill = climate_group,
      size = PC1_mean  # Use PC1_mean for size
    ),
    shape = 21,
    color = "black",
    stroke = 0.8,
    width = 1.6, height = 1.6,   # Strong jitter to spread overlapping points
    alpha = 0.5
  ) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Climate Group",
    values = c(
      "Temperate" = "#66c2a5",
      "Continental" = "#fc8d62",
      "Arid" = "#e78ac3",
      "Tropical" = "#a6d854",
      "Polar" = "#ffd92f"
    )
  ) +
  scale_size_continuous(
    name = "PC1 (Spore Shape Axis)",
    range = c(2, 10)
  ) +
  
  coord_quickmap(xlim = c(-130, -60), ylim = c(20, 55)) +
  
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold")
  ) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Amanita Sample Locations in the USA",
    subtitle = "Dot Size = PC1_mean (Spore Shape), Color = Climate Group",
    x = "Longitude",
    y = "Latitude"
  )
```


```{r, label="save climate map w pc1", echo=F, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
ggsave("Amanita_Climate_Map_with_PC1.jpg", width = 15, height = 15, dpi = 300)


```

```{r, label="save climate map w pc1", echo=F, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Select relevant columns for export
climate_export <- df_usa %>%
  dplyr::select(
    species,
    Lat_machine_readable,
    Long_machine_readable,
    koppen_code,
    koppen_label,
    climate_group,
    PC1_mean
  )

# Save as CSV
write.csv(climate_export, "Amanita_Climate_Summary.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```
